name: Blog Writer — Content Pipeline
description: Four-agent swarm that transforms a blog idea into a complete, illustrated article. Content Strategist plans the angle, Domain Researcher gathers evidence, Content Writer drafts the prose, and Illustrative Generator adds visuals.
author: AionUi
